ModMetaData.name: Geniuses Craft Fast Renew
ModMetaData.author: Buitrago - 1.6 update by nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Update of Buitrago's GeniusesCraftFast [1.3] to RimWorld 1.6.
I am not the author of this mod. The idea and the original patch are entirely Buitrago's - all I did was the work needed to make it run on 1.6. Credit goes to them; mistakes in the update are mine. If the original author comes back to it, or asks me to take this down, I will.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2625574564
What it does
Vanilla splits work speed in two. Where skill decides how good the result is - apparel, weapons, sculptures - the speed is deliberately left flat, and that is the General labor speed stat: no skill touches it. This mod hands it to Crafting.
The factor is 0.30 + 0.50 per crafting level:
- level 0: 30% - level 2: 130% - level 5: 280% - level 10: 530% - level 20: 1030%
Levels 0 and 1 are slower than vanilla; from level 2 on it is a straight gain, and a master crafter works about ten times faster. A colonist who never crafts stays at level 0, so 30% of vanilla speed on every general-labor job - including sculpting, which is the artist's work and not the crafter's. That trade is the mod, and the update keeps its numbers exactly.
On 1.6 the stat covers stone blocks, chemfuel, components, patchleather, smelting slag, cremation, tailoring apparel, smithing weapons, sculpting art, building musical instruments and crafting shells. Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly and Odyssey each add their own recipes and workbenches on the same stat, and they pick the bonus up on their own.
Mechanoids are unaffected. They have no skills, and the game applies the stat's no-skill factor to them instead of any skill need.
What changed in the 1.6 update
- The patch no longer assumes it is alone. GeneralLaborSpeed has no skill needs in vanilla, so the list has to be created; the original created it unconditionally, which writes a second list if another mod got there first. It now adds to an existing list when it finds one, and creates the list only when there is none. - Nothing else needed changing. The stat, the SkillNeed_BaseBonus class and the patch operations all crossed 1.3 to 1.6 intact - the stat's description in 1.6 is still word for word the one Buitrago quoted in 2021. Checked against RimWorld 1.6.4871.
XML only: no assembly, no dependency, no def of its own. Safe to add to an ongoing game, and safe to remove from one.
Do not run it alongside the original mod.
Source, changelog and the full list of what the update changed: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Geniuses-Craft-Fast-Renew
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic). Thanks to Buitrago for the mod.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
